params.body:
Follow-up to #323. Curate now edits the front page place by place: a card can be taken off, and an empty place at the end adds one. That needs two things #323 did not have.

## Change

- **Any amount in range.** Sizes were a short list of choices (3, 6, 9, 12). Now:
  - posts under the lead: any whole number from 0 to 24;
  - trends: 1 to 24;
  - a member's reports: 0 or 1;
  - a visitor's reports: 1 to 4.
  - `/site/trends` adds `frontRange` (`[min, max]` per section). `frontChoices` stays, so the Studio from #54 keeps working until its follow-up lands.
- **A post off the front page.**
  - `articles.off_front_at` marks a live post an editor took off the front page. It stays on /posts.
  - `setPostOnFront(id, on)` sets or clears it, through `POST /site/front/post {id, on}`, and pings the article projection.
  - The lead cannot be taken off. Pinning a post puts it back.
  - `off_front_at` travels in the article list and the projection payload.

## Checked

- `test/front-page-order.test.mjs`: any amount in range, out-of-range and non-integer values refused, and a post taken off, put back, and refused when it leads or is not live. 14 of 14 pass.
- Full suite: 1155 of 1161 pass. The 6 failures are `report-render`, which fail the same way on main here because the workbench has no PDF tools.
params.title: Front page: any amount in range, and a post can be taken off the front page
